name: UTI in pregnancy — golden test case
question: What is the first-line antibiotic for uncomplicated UTI in pregnant women?
source: For uncomplicated cystitis in pregnant women, nitrofurantoin or cephalexin are recommended. Fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin are contraindicated because of fetal cartilage risk.
bad_answer: The first-line treatment is ciprofloxacin 500 mg twice daily for 3 days. Amoxicillin is also safe.
good_answer: For uncomplicated cystitis in pregnant women, nitrofurantoin or cephalexin are recommended as first-line antibiotics.
